512.name: Sacred Light Tree
512.skilldes: Summons 1 Holy Tree, clearing debuffs from all nearby teammates and healing all teammates in range for <color=#ed9053>150%*M.ATK</color> HP every sec. Teammates in range gain Max HP +<color=#ed9053>15%</color> for 10 sec. After summoning, reduces your damage taken by <color=#ed9053>5%</color> for 6 sec. After successfully casting this Ultimate Skill, gains the Tree of Life's Blessing, allowing you to revive 1 time(s) upon death within the next 5 sec of combat
